study_identification_part.si4_title: Understanding the heterogeneity of dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug naïve depression using normative models

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: To combine dynamic features of fMRI data and normative modeling to provide quantitative and individualized metrics for delineating the biological heterogeneity of first-episode drug-naïve major depressive disorders (FEDN-MDD).
